---- Respondent
For Applicant : Ms. Naushina Afrin Ali, Advocate.

For Objector : Mr. Kishore Bhaduri, Senior
Advocate along with Mr. Sunil Sahu, Advocate.

For State/Respondent : Mr. Jitendra Shukla, P.L. Hon'ble Justice Smt. Rajani Dubey Order on
Board 20.01.2023
1.

The applicant has preferred this first bail application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C., as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.60/2022, registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Bilaspur (C.G.) for the offence punishable under Section 498A, 34 and 377 of IPC.
2.

The prosecution story, in brief, is that the complainant has filed a report in which it is alleged that she is a divorcee and met the present applicant at the work of mutual fund and they got married on 05.07.2011 and on the night of the marriage her sister-in-law, brother-in-law and husband assaulted her in the Ram Mandir premises on the pretext of suitcase, which was brought by her and on the next day her father-in-law demanded money from her on account of expenses incurred in marriage of the complainant and the present applicant.

Complainant further stated in her report that the applicant on account of impotency had coaxed the complainant to have a child from her brother-in-law, but she refused to do so, then she was beaten up by the applicant.

The applicant also have unnatural intercourse with her forcefully and her in-laws also forced her to sell the house of Alka Avenue or to register it in the name of her sister-in-law, failing which she was threatened with divorce.
Thereafter, a case was registered against the applicant and other accused persons for the aforesaid offences.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He further submits that her wife has tortured him mentally and also threatened him and to the entire family to implicate in a false case.

He further submits that he also file a case for dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1) of the Hindu Marriage Act on 01.06.2022 and after that as a counter blast FIR was lodged by the complainant on 20.10.2022.
Therefore, the applicant may kindly be granted anticipatory bail.
4. On the other hand, learned Senior counsel for the objector opposes the bail application and submits that the applicant submits the fake report to take advantage of the interim bail, therefore,
the applicant may not be released on anticipatory bail.
5. On the other hand, learned State counsel also opposes the bail application.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

7. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and having considered the submission made by the parties, nature of allegation, without commenting anything on the merits of the case,
the present is considered to be a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly,
the bail application is allowed.
